provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^315 - 1 with a(x) = x^16 + x^120 + x^151 + x^157 + x^158 + x^174 + x^208 + x^228 + x^259, b(x) = x^27 + x^37 + x^41 + x^49 + x^73 + x^80 + x^86 + x^89 + x^95 + x^190 + x^237 + x^240 + x^262; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
